subject: Complaints and the calls behind them
body:
You told the trade press in June that complaint handling at Westbury Mutual was being rebuilt end to end.

When quality checking covers one call in fifty, the habit behind a complaint is usually found weeks after it started. We read every recorded call, so the pattern shows up in the first week rather than the next quarter. Would it be useful to see what a week of your own calls looks like read back?
ask: Would it be useful to see what a week of your own calls looks like read back?
